summary: Pre-market brief for 2026-10-26; the fact layer was generated at 2026-10-26T11:37:13Z (07:37 ET), about 1 hour and 20 minutes before the US open. The risk score is 65.39, high_risk, up 2.21 on the day, with the regime at late_cycle. The rise is not a price-deterioration reading: 1.88 points of the 2.21-point move, roughly 85%, come from one cross-asset leg flipping — gold turning from down 1.2314 to up 0.4641, which lifted cross_asset from 62.50 to 75.00 (6 of 8 production signals triggered). Friday's settled US session was soft but orderly: the S&P proxy fell 0.5223 with money rotating into software (cybersecurity 3.2195, cloud 1.85, enterprise software 1.72), while fintech fell 1.7367 and gaming fell 1.5401; breadth did not improve, with 0.3831 of names above the 200-day and a new-low ratio of 0.2258 against 0.0194 on the new-high side. The overnight session that matters is China: the 11 A-share names closed down today, 4.9382% on average, with the memory and packaging chain taking the worst of it (600584 down 7.8287, 002156 down 7.7815, 688008 down 6.9556), after the same basket averaged a 3.3027% gain on Friday. Note that the rates, credit and volatility inputs in the score still carry the 2026-10-22 vintage (10-year 4.96, HY OAS 3.40, VIX 19.03); Friday's session is not in the composite.

top_risk_drivers.claim: Cross-asset confirmation reads 75.00, with 6 production signals triggered and 11.25 points contributed after the 0.8 proxy discount — still the model's largest single source. The newly lit leg is gold at 0.4641; the other 5 are level and trend legs: the dollar index at 121.4048 above 105 and the 10-year real rate at 2.64 above 1.5, plus the S&P proxy down 0.5223, Bitcoin down 0.0761, and small caps 8.6835 percentage points behind. Copper is up 0.6177, so copper_down stays untriggered.

HY OAS sits at 3.40, wider from 3.27, contributing 6.8496 points. It remains 0.6 points away from the 4 point trigger, so credit is not yet driving the index higher; the combination of widening spreads with weaker equities is what to watch. IG OAS is essentially flat at 0.89.

The 10-year real rate at 2.64 (from 2.76) contributes 4.9115 points; the nominal 10-year is 4.96 (from 5.13), the 2-year 4.65, and the 10y2y spread only 0.31 points. These prints carry the 2026-10-22 vintage and do not represent Friday's pricing.

VIX reads 19.03 (from 16.68), contributing 4.8448 points and forming the second half of the late_cycle rule (cross_asset at or above 0.55 together with VIX at or above 18). That print is also the 2026-10-22 vintage; the volatility dimension at 36.97 and realized volatility at 9.7513 both say elevated, not crisis.

Equity structure at 71.08 is the second contributor on the day (0.35 points): 0.3831 of names above the 200-day, a new-low ratio of 0.2258 against 0.0194 on new highs, small caps 8.6835 and semis 10.1920 percentage points behind. Breadth is the weakest link in this brief even as index level holds above water.

supporting_signals.claim: Of the 22 settled sector rows for Friday, 10 rose and 12 fell (mean 0.1234%), with leadership clustered in software: cybersecurity 3.2195, cloud 1.85, enterprise software 1.72 and AI software 1.5444. This is a rotation out of hardware and financials into software, not a broad liquidation.

Semis held on Friday: semis 0.7829 (MU up 2.4589, AMD up 1.7443, NVDA down 0.5890), semiconductor equipment 0.8038, and the SOXX proxy 0.5277. That contrasts with today's damage in the Chinese packaging chain.
Credit is not flashing: HY OAS 3.40 and IG OAS 0.89 both sit inside their thresholds, and the liquidity dimension is flat at 73.76.

One of the three Asia-tail readings is positive: consumer electronics 0.3732; memory 0.6584 and robotics 1.4163 are negative. Those three rows are 2026-10-23 to 2026-10-26 Asian-session readings, not US closes.

contradicting_signals.claim: The headline number is amplified by a single leg: 1.88 of the 2.21 points come from gold alone. Friday the S&P proxy fell only 0.5223 and VIX sat at 19.03; neither supports a narrative of accelerating risk.

The trend dimension is 47.45, price sits 4.5342% above the 200-day, the 52-week drawdown is -2.4542% and 3-month momentum is 2.8251% — the index's own structure remains constructive. What is weak is the internals, not the index.

China sold off structurally rather than broadly: per the news feed the Shanghai Composite closed up 0.19% at 3697.52, the Shenzhen Component fell 1.19% and ChiNext fell 1.71%, while the 11 names we track averaged a 4.9382% decline. The damage is concentrated in memory and packaging — an intra-sector giveback rather than a market-wide move.

what_changed_today: cross_asset moved from 62.50 to 75.00: gold went from down 1.2314 to up 0.4641, the triggered count went from 5 to 6, and the contribution rose 1.88 points. This is the fifth large swing through the same channel (earlier ones on 10-16, 10-21, 10-22 and 10-23).
The composite rose from 63.18 to 65.39 (2.21 points). Decomposed: cross_asset plus 1.88, equity structure plus 0.35, trend plus 0.02, macro minus -0.03.

The Chinese memory and packaging chain round-tripped: the 11 names averaged a 3.3027% gain on Friday and a 4.9382% decline today (median down 4.9006%), ranging from 688825 down only 0.4434% to 600584 down 7.8287%.
The sector table's internal split is worse than Friday afternoon's snapshot: 10 up and 12 down settled, versus 15 up and 7 down in the 10-23 late-session snapshot — the pre-close bounce did not hold.

On the vintage side there are no new rates, credit or volatility prints: rates, credit and VIX stop at 2026-10-22, breakevens and RRP reach 2026-10-23, and FX still stops at 2026-10-16. Today's score contains none of Friday's rate pricing.
watch_next: The FOMC on 2026-10-28 at 18:00Z is the week's single largest event; FedWatch implies 4.04 with the direction flagged as hike, so the market is not pricing cuts.
Earnings density picks up: MSFT and GOOGL report on 2026-10-28, AMZN, INTC and COIN on 2026-10-29. VZ already printed 1.31 today against a 1.27 forecast.

Anthropic files its S-1 today at 9am ET (21:00 Beijing); around the same window Meta went from more than 4% lower in pre-market to more than 2% higher. AI software has an event-driven volatility source today.

Two tripwires in credit and rates: HY OAS at 3.40 sits 0.6 points from the 4 point trigger, and whether the 10-year holds below 5 from 4.96. A breach on either would add to both the 73.76 and 74.40 dimensions at once.

Breadth and volatility decide whether the regime can revert: the new-low ratio needs to retreat from 0.2258 and VIX needs to fall from 19.03 back below 18; until then the late_cycle test keeps passing.

bull_case.title: Bull case: the gold leg unwinds and software leadership broadens
points: If gold gives back its 0.4641 gain, cross_asset falls back to 62.50 and that single line removes 1.88 points, returning the score near 63.18.
If the new-low ratio retreats from 0.2258 and VIX falls from 19.03 back below 18, both late_cycle conditions fail together.
If software leadership persists (cybersecurity 3.2195, cloud 1.85), breadth repairs faster than the index level.

base_case.title: Base case: the score grinds between 60 and 70 with high_risk intact
points: The binary cross-asset legs keep producing day-to-day swings of about 1.875 points, directed by single-day gold and copper moves rather than by equity pricing.
The Chinese memory and packaging chain is this week's swing factor: it averaged a 4.9382% decline today while the Shanghai Composite closed up 0.19%, so the pressure is intra-sector.
The 2026-10-28 FOMC and the MSFT and GOOGL reports land in the same week, so risk appetite is unlikely to expand before those events.

bear_case.title: Bear case: the China unwind reaches credit and the score tests 70
points: If HY OAS moves from 3.40 toward the 4 point trigger while the real rate stays above 2.64, both the 73.76 liquidity dimension and the 74.40 macro dimension add at once.
If semis relative underperformance widens from 10.1920 percentage points and the new-low ratio rises from 0.2258, equity structure at 71.08 closes the remaining gap.
If today's 7.8287% to 7.7815% declines in the Chinese packaging chain carry into next week, they transmit into the score through semis relative strength.
